| # Emergency flashing through CB-ME {#emergency-flashing-through-cb-me-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Emergency flashing is a mechanism which provides an option within CB-ME (starting rbr_CB_ME_ML_V03.02.00 onwards) to reprogram the ECU when the defined inhibit pins (K21 and K22) are set to high.

This could be a fallback solution for situations where the ASW shows abnormal behavior and the re-programming request is never detected by it.

## Emergency flashing procedure {#emergency-flashing-procedure .p_Heading2 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

- When the control comes to CB-ME after a T15 or T30 Off/ On reset, the two inhibits are checked based on the pre-conditions. If both the inhibit pins are observed as high, then CB-ME will wait for Wt (currently configured as 50ms).

- If the re-programming request is received before Wt elapses, then CB-ME will perform re-programming of the software with standard CAN settings as given below:

CAN 2.0B -

  CAN Channel   Baud Rate   Node ID   Sampling point
  ------------- ----------- --------- ----------------
  CAN 2         250 Kbps    01        80%

- If there is no emergency flashing request, then CB-ME will evaluate the conditions and decide its further course of action. Based on this evaluation, it may re-initialize the CAN settings with NVM settings as per project or customer specific configuration and decide to stay in CB, or perform an internal reset and start the ASW.

For detailed steps on how to perform the emergency flashing through BODAS-service, please refer User Manual BODAS-service 4.4.8 (and onwards).

 

+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0 auto 0 auto;width:2.2083in;height:0.7188in;border:none"} | •Emergency flashing uses security level 1. The security levels in HSM will remain unchanged.                                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                            | •If CB-ME re-programming is requested by ASW/BSW there is no change in the current re-programming procedure.                                                                                                                                        |
|                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                            | •The entry condition for emergency flashing is either a T15 or T30 Off/ On reset. It is not supported for any other reset type.                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                            | •Concept is for T15 enabled systems and is validated accordingly.                                                                                                                                                                                   |
|                                                                                            |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
|                                                                                            | •Emergency flashing is typically not possible when the RC4x is installed on a machine because both the inhibit pins must be pulled to high and the fixed CAN setting for emergency flashing might be different from the CAN setting on the machine. |
